LESSON: COMPILATION OF THE QUR’AN

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Study of the Quran and Hadith
Topic 1.1: Compilation of the Qur’an
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 6

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Compilation of the Qur’an, part of Study of the Quran and Hadith in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: Why was it important to compile the Qur’an?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. research online or from available reference materials on the circumstances of compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an during the reigns of caliphs Abubakar (R.A.) and Uthman (R.A.) and present in class (appropriate colour contrast and font size should be considered for learners with low vision

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. research online or from available reference materials on the circumstances of compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an during the reigns of caliphs Abubakar (R.A.) and Uthman (R.A.) and present in class (appropriate colour contrast and font size should be considered for learners with low vision

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Compilation of the Qur’an together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Digital Literacy: the skills of connecting using digital technology and interacting with digital technology are enhanced as

learners research online on the circumstances of compilation of the Qur’an during the reigns of caliphs Abubakar (R.A.) and

Uthman (R.A.) and present in class

• Communication and Collaboration: the skills of listening, speaking, writing and team work are developed as learners work

in pairs or small groups as they brainstorm on the significance of compilation of the Qur’an and make notes.

• Learning to learn: the skill of sharing learnt knowledge as learners’ research online or from available resources on the

circumstances of compilation of the Qur’an during the reigns of caliphs Abubakar (R.A.) and Uthman (R.A.) and present

in class.

• Creativity and imagination: the skill of networking is enhanced as learners demonstrate the qualities of the compilers of

the Qur’an

17

Values:
• Responsibility: accountability is enhanced as learners demonstrate the qualities of the compilers of the Qur’an

• Respect: etiquette is enhanced as learners respect each other’s opinion as they brainstorm in groups on the significance of

compiling the Qur’an and write notes

• Unity: cooperation is enhanced as learners work in pairs or groups as they discuss the significance of compilation of the

Qur’an

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Life Skills: Assertiveness as they demonstrate the qualities of the compilers of the Qur’an
